top_signals.title: Trump's diesel deal with Russia equals less than two weeks of U.S. demand
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump's diesel deal with Russia comes as he is under pressure to reduce fuel prices with the U.S. midterm elections less than a month way.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: CMORG holds sector-wide cloud outage simulation exercise
top_signals.summary: The Cross-Market Operational Resilience Group (CMORG) yesterday (8 October 2026) completed its biennial simulation exercise, known as SIMEX26, focused this year on a global cloud services disruption.

top_signals.summary: Preston factors (earnings and interest factors) are provided for employers.

top_signals.title: Job quality is a priority in the EU, according to annual Commission report
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 13 Oct 2026 The quality of jobs in the EU has improved over the past decade, according to the 2026 European Employment and Social Outlook, published today.
